descriere:
Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT
Who we are: 
 Open-minded intellectuals who embrace emerging technologies on our mission to create innovative Software Engineering Solutions that will impact millions of users around the world . 
 We are looking for: 
 We are seeking an experienced Test Automation Engineer to join us.
 What you will do: 
Design and build the automation framework: Gherkin feature files, Pytest fixtures, Playwright configuration and a Page Object Model that survives UI changes. 
Automate the eight agreed functional areas, covering record management, creation and modification flows, watchlists, multi-evaluator assessments, campaign tracking, scope configuration and reporting views. 
Keep flakiness down on a UI with dynamic elements, using Playwright auto-waiting and locator strategies that do not break on every release. 
Work with the DevOps engineer on the CI/CD pipeline, the Dockerized test environment, parallel execution and Allure reporting. 
Run the full suite in staging, triage failures, and tell real defects apart from test defects. 
Maintain the suite as the application changes, so the regression run stays trustworthy enough that people act on it. 
Write the documentation: running tests locally, pipeline setup and troubleshooting. 
Work with the application's developer to get access, understand workflows and data structures, and clear blockers early rather than late. 
 What you must have: 
Relevant experience in Automation testing (automation framework development)
Python/Pytest
Playwright
Gherkin
 What's in it for you: 
Continuous learning opportunities to enhance your professional and soft skills
A great working environment with people who put their heart, mind, and soul into everything they do and understand the importance of team spirit.
 We really welcome open-minded and committed people: 
Eager to take on new challenges and learn new things
Who put their heart, mind, and soul into everything they do
Who enjoy sharing knowledge and understand the importance of teams.
 SII Romania is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. We are committed to promoting diversity, equality and inclusion within our workforce and working environment.
